falseSynonyms.zh: 工具箱不等於 kit toolbox 是裝工具的箱子；kit 是成套物品本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A toolbox is the container, not necessarily the kit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 設備不等於 kit equipment 通常是不可數總稱；kit 是一套預先組合的物品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Equipment is a broad mass noun.

falseSynonyms.zh: 用品不等於所有 kit supplies 常偏消耗品；kit 可包含工具、設備、零件和說明書。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Supplies are often only part of a kit.

falseSynonyms.zh: package 與 kit 接近但更偏商業組合 package 可包括服務或軟件，不一定是實體任務套件。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Package is broader and more commercial.

falseSynonyms.zh: set 與 kit 接近但缺少『為任務預先配置』意味 set 只表示一組相關物品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A set need not be task-specific.

falseSynonyms.zh: gear 偏整體裝備，不一定預先打包 gear 常用於戶外、運動、攝影等器材總稱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Gear is equipment in general, not necessarily a kit.

falseSynonyms.zh: bundle 是一起銷售／供應的組合，不一定能完成某任務 零售 bundle 和 functional kit 的重點不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A bundle is grouped for sale; a kit is often grouped for use.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可數性陷阱 kit 通常可數：a kit / two kits；equipment 通常不可數。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Kit is countable; equipment is usually uncountable.
